ambient_events: A card comes loose from a rack end and settles on the floor face down.
The shelving shifts a fraction under its own weight and holds.
description: A long municipal room behind the concourse, racked floor to ceiling with steel shelving that has rusted into one continuous object. What's on the shelves was paper and is now a grey compacted mass with the ghosts of ledger lines in it. None of that stops the cataloguing. Fresh index cards are pinned along the rack ends in a dense, careful hand, numbering shelves whose contents nobody will ever read, and a clipboard hangs on a nail by the door with today's date at the top of it.
name: The Records Hall
